# crosswork_golden_config_global_variables (Resource)

This resource can manage a global variable of Golden Configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_golden_config_global_variables" "example" {
  name  = "cwtest_ntp_server"
  type  = "STRING"
  value = "10.1.1.1"
}

# A secret stays out of the plan and the state.
resource "crosswork_golden_config_global_variables" "secret" {
  name             = "cwtest_ntp_key"
  value_wo         = var.ntp_key
  value_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Variable name, 1 to 64 letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `type` (String) Type of the value
  - Choices: `STRING`, `JSON`
  - Default value: `STRING`
- `value` (String) Value of the variable; for the type `JSON` a JSON document
  - **Required**: exactly one of `value` and `value_wo` must be set.
  - This attribute stores the value in Terraform state. Use `value_wo` together with `value_wo_version` for a secret: the controller returns the value in clear text on a read, but it stays out of the plan and the state.
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Value of the variable
  - **Required**: exactly one of `value` and `value_wo` must be set.
- `value_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `value_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new value. The version is stored in state; the value is not.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `variable_id` (String) The id the controller gave the variable

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_golden_config_global_variables.example "<name>"
```
